analysis.summary: The UK is considering a ban on social media use for individuals under 16, following reports of cryptocurrency thefts totaling $700 million using traditional methods. Google appealed against an antitrust ruling related to its search dominance. Wage growth has slowed with employment numbers falling. Toy retailers are closely monitoring the potential social media ban. President Trump threatens tariffs on Greenland, causing diplomatic tension with Europe. Netflix revised its bid for Warner Bros. to an all-cash offer amid competition from Paramount. Tech startups like Emergent (India) secured significant funding rounds. Meta's Oversight Board ruled on permanent bans in a landmark case. SpaceX's Crew Dragon Democratization Mission is nearing launch. The new Marathon game will debut on March 5. Apple is rumored to refresh the M5 MacBook Pro soon. BYD outperformed Tesla, raising questions about market dominance. Spotify tested audiobook syncing with paper editions. Adobe introduced AI-powered video editing tools in Premiere. Rad Power Bikes faced a warehouse fire linked to flammable batteries.
